threads.body: Removed as duplicate dead code. This class instrumented `org.jboss.resteasy.plugins.server.servlet.ServletContainerDispatcher#service` to initialize `JaxrsContextPath` from the `servletMappingPrefix` field — identical behavior to `ResteasyServletContainerDispatcherInstrumentation` in the shared `jaxrs-2.0-resteasy-common-3.0` module, which `Resteasy30InstrumentationModule` already registers. Both were applying the same advice to the same type, so the module-local copy was dropped in favor of the common one.
